description.en-US:
Reader's Launcher turns the home screen into a single column of words. No icons,
no colours, no wallpaper: white on black, or black on white — flip between the two
with a double tap, from the "Reader's theme" quick-settings tile, or in settings.

* Tiles are plain text: an app, or a category that opens a text list of apps.
* A grid of 3 to 5 squares pinned at the bottom holds the unavoidable apps (phone,
  messages…) with their icons rendered as monochrome glyphs.
* Built-in widgets: clock; weather (Open-Meteo, no account, tap for five days);
  agenda (next event, swipe for the following ones); tasks (first task of a
  Tasks.org list, tick to complete, + to add — Tasks.org syncs with CalDAV, Google
  Tasks, Microsoft To Do or keeps lists offline). Standard app widgets can be added too.
* Swipe up for the alphabetical app list with search and the usual long-press
  actions (add to home, category, rename, hide, app info, uninstall).
* Swipe up and hold on the home screen for a text list of recently used apps.
* Swipe down for notifications. Export and import the whole setup as a JSON file.
* Two books beside the home screen: swipe right or left to read (EPUB, MOBI, FB2,
  text), tap to turn pages, position remembered per book. Reading made effortless.
* English by default; French, German, Spanish, Portuguese and Russian when the device
  uses them.

Serif, sans or monospace; three text sizes; left or centred. No ads, no tracking.
